relationships.subject: chronic morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: Chronic morphine treatments for 7 days reduced the protein expression of MKP-1 and MKP-3 in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: Coadministration of CB2 receptor agonist AM1241 alleviated the inhibition of MKP-1 and MKP-3 by chronic morphine administration

relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: Our previous study showed that a cannabinoid type 2 (CB2) receptor agonist attenuated morphine tolerance.

relationships.subject: triptolide
relationships.evidence_quote: The effect of the CB2 receptor agonist on morphine-induced downregulation of MKP-1 and MKP-3 was reversed by the MKP-1 and MKP-3 antagonist triptolide.

relationships.subject: MKP-1
relationships.evidence_quote: CB2 receptor agonist may induce the expression of MKP-1 and MKP-3 to promote MAPK dephosphorylation

key_findings: CB2 agonist AM1241 restores morphine-suppressed MKP-1/MKP-3 and reduces p-MAPK and cytokines in spinal cord
MKPs may be a target for alleviating morphine tolerance
